An '''artillery remote''' allowed an individual to operate [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapons from an optimal distance. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] soldiers used artillery remotes during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
